scenario: I’ve been helping my aunt sort her medications ever since she began experiencing seizures. Recently, my aunt received a new prescription that she clearly hates taking due to how she despises swallowing pills. Her doctor told her that if she didn’t take her medication, her next seizure would be fatal. Right now, it is the scheduled time for my aunt to take her medication. She is refusing to take it. If I choke my aunt unconscious, I can make my aunt take her medication and she will continue to live. If I do not do this, my aunt will experience a fatal seizure and die.
choice: I decide to choke my aunt unconscious
outcomes: My aunt experiences the medication's impaired attention and memory side effects
My aunt experiences distress from having medication forced on her
